summary.text: Noemi Legaspi is the Republican and Libertarian Party candidate for the Oregon House of Representatives, District 22, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Lesly Muñoz (D).
Ballotpedia lists Woodburn School District 103, Position 2, as a prior office she held.
